# `firearms.data` — root

Every type with its summary and every non-private constructor, method and constant. The
signature is the contract; read the source only when the summary is not enough.

The data loaders turning data/firearms/weapon/*.json and data/firearms/attachment/*.json into firearms.model values (`FA-3`, `docs/spec/domains/weapon.md` `WEAPON-DEC-003`), plus the codecs and the two lookup registries that back them.

### `class AttachmentDataLoader` — `src/main/java/firearms/data/AttachmentDataLoader.java`
Reads data/firearms/attachment/*.json into AttachmentRegistry on every resource reload (`docs/spec/domains/attach.md` §2 "Multiplicity").
- `AttachmentDataLoader()`
- `void apply(Map<Identifier, AttachmentFile> loaded, ResourceManager resourceManager, ProfilerFiller profiler)`
- `Identifier getFabricId()`

### `record AttachmentFile(Slot slot, List<Modifier> modifiers, double zoom)` — `src/main/java/firearms/data/AttachmentFile.java`
A data/firearms/attachment/*.json file's own fields — slot, modifiers and optional zoom — without the attachment's own id, which is its file's name (`docs/spec/domains/attach.md` §3).
- `Codec<Slot> SLOT`
- `Codec<AttachmentFile> CODEC`
- `Attachment toAttachment(String id)` — This file's data plus its own id (the file's name), as the rest of this mod reads it.

### `class AttachmentRegistry` — `src/main/java/firearms/data/AttachmentRegistry.java`
The attachments currently loaded from data/firearms/attachment/*.json (`docs/spec/domains/attach.md` §2 "Multiplicity"), refreshed on every data reload by AttachmentDataLoader.
- `Optional<Attachment> get(Identifier id)` — The attachment named id, if a currently-loaded data file defines one (`WEAPON-FAIL-004`).
- `Map<Identifier, Attachment> all()` — Every currently-loaded attachment, keyed by id.
- `void set(Map<Identifier, Attachment> loaded)`

### `class DataRegistration` — `src/main/java/firearms/data/DataRegistration.java`
Registers this mod's two data reload listeners (`FA-3`): WeaponDataLoader and AttachmentDataLoader, both server-data listeners since neither needs anything client-only.
- `void register()`

### `class EnumCodec` — `src/main/java/firearms/data/EnumCodec.java`
A Codec for any enum, reading and writing Ids#slug(Enum): a weapon or attachment data file spells WeaponClass.ASSAULT_RIFLE as "assault_rifle", Caliber.ACP_45 as "acp_45", and so on, for every enum `firearms.model` exposes (`docs/spec/domains/weapon.md` §3, `docs/spec/domains/attach.md` §3).
- `<E extends Enum<E>> Codec<E> of(Class<E> type)`

### `class ModifierCodec` — `src/main/java/firearms/data/ModifierCodec.java`
One attachment modifier: { stat, op, value } (`docs/spec/domains/attach.md` §3).
- `Codec<Stat> STAT`
- `Codec<Op> OP`
- `Codec<Modifier> CODEC`

### `class StatsCodec` — `src/main/java/firearms/data/StatsCodec.java`
A base weapon's bare Stats (`docs/spec/domains/weapon.md` §3's roster table columns).
- `Codec<FireMode> FIRE_MODE`
- `Codec<Stats> CODEC`

### `record WeaponBaseFile(WeaponClass weaponClass, Caliber caliber, Stats baseStats)` — `src/main/java/firearms/data/WeaponBaseFile.java`
A data/firearms/weapon/*.json file's own fields — class, caliber and base_stats — without the weapon's own id, which is its file's name rather than a field of its own (`docs/spec/domains/weapon.md` §3, `WEAPON-DEC-003`).
- `Codec<WeaponClass> WEAPON_CLASS`
- `Codec<Caliber> CALIBER`
- `Codec<WeaponBaseFile> CODEC`
- `WeaponBase toWeaponBase(String id)` — This file's data plus its own id (the file's name), as the rest of this mod reads it.

### `class WeaponDataLoader` — `src/main/java/firearms/data/WeaponDataLoader.java`
Reads data/firearms/weapon/*.json into WeaponRegistry on every resource reload (`docs/spec/domains/weapon.md` `WEAPON-DEC-003`, `docs/spec/contracts/public-surface.md`).
- `WeaponDataLoader()`
- `void apply(Map<Identifier, WeaponBaseFile> loaded, ResourceManager resourceManager, ProfilerFiller profiler)`
- `Identifier getFabricId()`

### `class WeaponRegistry` — `src/main/java/firearms/data/WeaponRegistry.java`
The base weapons currently loaded from data/firearms/weapon/*.json (`docs/spec/domains/weapon.md` `WEAPON-DEC-003`), refreshed on every data reload by WeaponDataLoader.
- `Optional<WeaponBase> get(Identifier id)` — The weapon named id, if a currently-loaded data file defines one (`WEAPON-FAIL-004` for when it does not).
- `Map<Identifier, WeaponBase> all()` — Every currently-loaded base weapon, keyed by id.
- `void set(Map<Identifier, WeaponBase> loaded)`
